Messages.Author: alf
Messages.Body:
Umh. as I stumbled upon this again on vdb.im and it was entered in this way, this looks really really wrong. 7 damaging votes with 4 situational ones (Neonate Breach) quite don't make reliably GWs or 4 VP on a table, I suppose.

Comparing to other LoP decks this looks like switched ratios and should probably be
1x Kindred Segregation
15x Kine Resources Contested

Makes me wonder how many more "typos" are to be found in the TWD ...
